reference_benchmark.title: This Shape Saved Roller Coasters
reference_benchmark.optical_flow_audit_grid: 270x480 (DISOpticalFlow every 2nd frame; multiply px by 4.0 for 1080x1920)

failure_modes: hi_w prompt truncation sliced off action verbs leaving 0-verb static poses
Start-Frame Climax Trap baked final post-action pose into kf_start PNG (floating tilted chair C01, pre-placed portrait C09)
Liquid 2D ink deformation verb ('eyes shift') melted charcoal eyes on white vinyl head (C04)
Top-down/wide bird's-eye camera broke character scale (giant vs toddler C10, concrete block clipping C03)
dolly_zoom_vertigo warped room walls like jelly (C16)
Single static pose held 4.4s-5.8s without secondary beat

three_phase_beat_physics_law.pattern_formula: State-A (Untriggered Poise) -> Snappy Action (0.4-0.8s Ballistic Limb/Prop Impulse) -> Clean Hold (Decelerated Silhouette + 2D Step-Snap Expression)

phase_1_state_a_anticipation.start_keyframe_mandate: Start keyframe PNG MUST depict pre-action State-A equilibrium (all four chair legs flat on floor, prop held in hands BEFORE placement, closed wallet/folder at chest, closed door with hand reaching for knob). NEVER depict climax/mid-air State-B in kf_start.

phase_2_snappy_action.kinematic_rule: Drive motion through shoulder/elbow/torso + rigid prop displacement, never through slow floating drift or camera-only zoom.

phase_3_clean_hold_and_reaction.hold_rule: Settle limbs cleanly onto prop/surface contact while snapping 2D ink expression across a single fast blink or 10-15 degree head tilt.

prompt_assembly_guardrails.front_load_subject_and_verb_rule: Place [Explicit Character Subject + Wardrobe] + [12-22w Snappy Action Clause] inside the FIRST 28 words of the Flow prompt, BEFORE secondary room/lighting descriptors, preventing word-cap truncation from ever dropping the verb.

standardized_shot_tiers.use_case: High-impact 2D expression step-snaps + chest-level hand props (wallet flip, phone to ear, photo reveal)
Core clinical/domestic 2-beat prop interactions (desk chair pushback, easel set-down, twig snap, clipboard tap)
Doorway threshold entries, two-person spatial standoff, stepping into simulator/test chair with full floor contact shadow

banned_human_cut_framings: 90-degree vertical top-down dive onto indoor characters (causes giant-vs-toddler scale collapse)
Distant exterior bird's-eye shots where acting human is < 25% of frame height (unless pure K0->K1 landmark drone establish with 0 acting requirement)
dolly_zoom_vertigo or background-warping lens prompts (causes rubber-wall distortion)
Lower-body occluded half-buried inside foreground concrete/furniture blocks in Previs start frame
